_how: Hand-picked Flavor 10s for Saturday (Rewind) and Sunday (Reset), one per Nairobi date. Every credit and year is checked against 2+ sources before it goes in. A song can't come back on any Flavor 10 for 28 days. week.py publishes the list on its date; a weekend with no entry here shows Monday-to-Friday lists only.
